species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 16–24 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 85 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 130 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 18 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
